description: Query free/busy information for one or more calendars over a time range.

items.description: Calendars/groups to query, as JSON array string, e.g. '[{"id":"primary"}]'

timeMax.description: End of the interval, RFC3339 timestamp

timeMin.description: Start of the interval, RFC3339 timestamp (e.g. "2026-03-10T00:00:00Z")

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the response (e.g. "America/Los_Angeles")

name: calendar_freebusy_query
